name: comp-103
title: Pill Vote Buttons
description: A light fully-rounded pill split into three touching parts: a chevron-up button, a bold count and a chevron-down button. Hovering or pressing either end shades that section.
use: Readers should push a visible score up or down with one tap, as on a forum post or comment.
avoid: The count is a fixed literal and the buttons have no click handler, so a vote never changes the number.
a11y: Both ends are labelled Upvote and Downvote with focus rings, but nothing changes the score, so the control stays decorative. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide white pill sits on a near-black stage, its three sections divided by faint seams and the outer ends fully round. A dark chevron points up on the left, the score "235" sits in bold in the centre, and a matching chevron points down on the right.
behaves: Hovering either chevron darkens its section of the pill and pressing darkens it further, giving vote feedback; the count itself stays fixed. Once the pointer leaves, the pill returns to flat white.
customise: Nothing is exposed as a prop: the score is a literal and neither button has an action, so wiring real votes needs a source edit.
weight: light: Three small static elements with only hover and press colour feedback.
